activity_summary: After Errors you stood at the reckoning long enough to hear that today's gallery is not all in. Heminges left Monday's eleven pound eight where it was and struck no new share. You did not count the coffer. Edith's eight shillings stayed a promise till Lady Day, and you did not mix it into the cloth. You left with Burbage for the Jackdaw before any new sum existed.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a total he had not seen, and left.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Kept today uncast and Monday already said.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Accepted a reckoning that could not yet disappoint him.

facets.activity: Left the reckoning for the Jackdaw

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Eleven pound eight, to the sharers' side. Today is not that paper.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: No item of a share today.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not write a total.

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: Bring the pages, not the book of accounts.
